residency_notes: Morph says primary data processing occurs in the United States, with regional data centers available for paid and enterprise customers and self-hosted deployments available for customer-controlled residency. Free and paid tiers retain content for up to 90 and 30 days respectively; enterprise has true Zero Data Retention.
prompt_training_notes: Morph says it does not use inputs and outputs to train its models by default, with limited support/debugging exceptions and stronger zero-retention protections for enterprise customers.
